scope: Final-source manuscript build reconstructed from the preserved 204-file consolidation manuscript corpus with the current main WoW_unified.tex and final_delivery_note.tex blobs. This is typesetting/build evidence, not full-repository CI and not a mathematical proof audit.
notes: The builder initially returned page_count=null because TeX wrapped the word 'pages' across a log line; the final build-helper follow-up makes that parser whitespace-tolerant and fail-closed.
Successive PDF binaries can differ in metadata/document identifiers although spot-rendered pages are byte-identical; no final binary-PDF reproducibility claim is made from this check.
GitHub Actions runner provisioning remained a separate cloud-infrastructure issue at the time of this local finalization check.
